acip: RAB RIB CAN MA YIN PA'I MIG GIS SKRA SHAD MA MTHONG BA'I TSUL DU, PHUNG SOGS KYI RANG BZHIN GANG DU GZIGS PA'I YUL DE NI SANGS RGYAS DE RNAMS KYI DON DAM PA'I BDEN PA'O,,
english: They are considering these things just as the person whose eyes have no cataracts, and who sees no strands of hair. They look at the same thing—the same parts of the person and so on that were seen as having some nature of their own—and perceive it as the ultimate reality of the Buddhas. Knowing by failing to see
